paragraphs: Firefighter-owned • South Louisiana local
Professional flower bed weed control and fertilization for mulch, rock, pine straw, and landscaped beds—carefully applied around the plants you want to keep.

Pulling weeds provides a quick reset, but it does little to slow the next wave. Grow Green combines careful control of visible weeds with a preventive strategy designed for South Louisiana’s long growing season.
A smarter bed-care strategy
Each property is evaluated before treatment, then the right combination is selected for the weeds, bed material, desirable plants, and season.
We identify active weeds and use targeted post-emergent applications where the label and surrounding plant material allow. Difficult or mature weeds may require more than one treatment.
Pre-emergent creates a preventive barrier that reduces many weeds before they germinate. It is a major advantage over pulling alone, though no barrier stops every weed.
When bed fertilization is part of your plan, we apply appropriate nutrients to support color and healthy growth without turning the visit into a one-size-fits-all blanket application.

Product selection and treatment timing vary by plant species, weed pressure, weather, bed condition, and label requirements. Your technician will explain any special preparation or re-entry instructions.
Common South Louisiana problems
Broadleaf weeds, sedges, and unwanted grasses respond differently. Identification matters—especially when the weed is growing beside a flower, shrub, or groundcover you want protected.
Clear expectations create better results and fewer surprises.
Simple from the start
Send the service address and tell us what you are seeing in your beds.
Our local team evaluates the bed layout, size, condition, and service needs.
You receive straightforward recommendations and pricing without pressure.
Scheduled visits help control active weeds and keep prevention working.
The Grow Green difference
We are a South Louisiana treatment company. Your property is cared for by a local team that understands our climate and answers when you call.
Professional products are applied according to their labels by a trained local team.
Service updates, applicable instructions, and a real local office when you need help.
Flexible service designed to keep your business through results—not lock-in.
Recommendations built around local plants, weeds, heat, humidity, and long growing seasons.

Our standard service focuses on professional weed-control applications, prevention, and selected plant nutrition. Routine hand-weeding, mulching, edging, pruning, and landscape installation are not included unless they appear as a separate item on your quote.

That depends on the bed material, weed pressure, season, irrigation, and how clean you want the beds to remain. Ongoing service generally provides more consistent prevention than occasional one-time treatments. We will recommend a practical schedule after reviewing the property.

We apply products according to their labels and provide any applicable re-entry instructions after service. Keep people and pets away from treated areas until the stated re-entry condition—often once the application is dry—has been met.

    Straight answers

    Flower bed service FAQs

    Still unsure whether this is the right service?

    Talk with our local office
    Will treatment hurt my flowers or shrubs?

    We identify the desirable plants and use precision application methods and products only where their labels allow. Because ornamentals vary in sensitivity, the technician may avoid certain areas or recommend a different approach when treatment would create unnecessary risk.

    Does pre-emergent stop every weed?

    No. Pre-emergent can greatly reduce many weeds before they germinate, but it does not control every species and it does not kill weeds that are already growing. Weather, irrigation, soil disturbance, and the condition of the bed can also affect performance.

    How quickly will existing weeds die?

    Timing depends on the weed, product, growth stage, and weather. Some weeds show symptoms within days, while others decline more slowly or require a follow-up treatment. We avoid promising an overnight result that the biology cannot support.

    Do I need to pull the weeds before the first visit?

    Usually, no. Leave the weeds in place until we evaluate them unless our office tells you otherwise. Foliage can help with identification and may be needed for certain post-emergent treatments to work effectively.

    Do you hand-pull weeds, install mulch, or trim plants?

    Our standard service focuses on professional weed-control applications, prevention, and selected plant nutrition. Routine hand-weeding, mulching, edging, pruning, and landscape installation are not included unless they appear as a separate item on your quote.

    How often should flower beds be treated?

    That depends on the bed material, weed pressure, season, irrigation, and how clean you want the beds to remain. Ongoing service generally provides more consistent prevention than occasional one-time treatments. We will recommend a practical schedule after reviewing the property.

    What about children and pets?

    We apply products according to their labels and provide any applicable re-entry instructions after service. Keep people and pets away from treated areas until the stated re-entry condition—often once the application is dry—has been met.

    What areas do you serve?

    Grow Green serves Greater Baton Rouge and nearby Ascension and Livingston Parish communities, including St. Amant, Prairieville, Gonzales, Geismar, Dutchtown, Sorrento, Denham Springs, Walker, Central, Zachary, and surrounding areas.
